newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Auto started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Auto started as buy.

text.p: --ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Wednesday it initiated coverage of United Auto Group Inc with a buy rating. Its six-to-12-month price target on the stock is $39.
--Its earnings-per-share estimates are $1.14 (pro forma) for 1996 and $1.55 for 1997.

--The company, which operates franchised auto dealerships, has a geographically diverse dealership network which reduces its dependence on any one area of the country, noted analyst Mark Mandel in a report.
